scope: are the new patent sources eligible for historical time research?

epo.why: the publication server serves the document as published; there is no record-level version history, so we observe a fixed published artefact
epo.date_confusion_note: INID 43 (application publication) and INID 45 (grant) are both present on granted documents and are separated by years; the connector records both and selects by kind

cipo.why: single quarterly extract ending 2022-02-28; only Grant Date is a recorded public-availability date, pending applications have none
cipo.date_confusion_note: Filing Date must never be used as an observation date; the 18-month laid-open rule is a rule, not a recorded field, and is deliberately not applied

verdict: EP publications are eligible for historical-observability work: every record has a recorded public date and a filing date, and the gap is measured per record. CIPO is eligible only for granted patents and is snapshot-limited; its ownership timeline is the more valuable feature and is dated.
